centos-5.name: CentOS 5.11 (netinstall from the vault)
centos-5.notes: CentOS 5.11 (September 2014, the last of the 5 series, kernel 2.6.18): the netinstall CD asks where the repository is: HTTP, server vault.centos.org, directory /5.11/os/x86_64/. The 5.x kernel drives the virtio disk and NIC (since 5.3). Manual for now: almalinux-server's kickstart flow is the road to unattended, the anaconda of that era takes ks= on the serial console.

centos-6.name: CentOS 6.10 (minimal)
centos-6.notes: CentOS 6.10 (July 2018, kernel 2.6.32, the last 6): the minimal ISO installs a base system from itself. Afterwards yum needs the vault: replace mirrorlist with baseurl=http://vault.centos.org/6.10/os/x86_64/ in CentOS-Base.repo (mirrorlist.centos.org is gone).

centos-7.name: CentOS 7.9.2009 (kickstart, minimal ISO)
centos-7.notes: CentOS 7.9.2009 (November 2020, kernel 3.10, end of life June 2024): bootstrap-kickstart from the minimal ISO (packages on the medium, inst.repo=cdrom), @core plus sshd and the guest agent; %post points yum at vault.centos.org (mirror.centos.org is gone). Born experimental (written 2026-09-29 ahead of a live run): vmctl check-vms centos-7 runs one. CentOS 5 and 6 stay manual: their anaconda takes ks= and method= instead of inst.*, a legacy kickstart flow still to write. Anaconda 21 predates autopart --noswap (line 15 of the kickstart stopped the first live run, 2026-09-30): the profile asks for --type=plain alone.

post_install_run: sudo yum -q -y makecache >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo dnf -q -y makecache >/dev/null 2>&1; grep -l 'vault.centos.org' /etc/yum.repos.d/*.repo | head -1

centos-8.name: CentOS Linux 8.5.2111 (kickstart, vault repositories)
centos-8.notes: CentOS Linux 8.5.2111 (November 2021, the last CentOS Linux 8): bootstrap-kickstart from the boot ISO with the vault's BaseOS as inst.repo (the medium carries no packages, its own inst.stage2 is read from the ISO), @core plus sshd and the guest agent; %post points dnf at vault.centos.org. Born experimental (written 2026-09-29 ahead of a live run): vmctl check-vms centos-8 runs one. CentOS 5 and 6 stay manual: their anaconda takes ks= and method= instead of inst.*, a legacy kickstart flow still to write.

post_install_run: sudo yum -q -y makecache >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo dnf -q -y makecache >/dev/null 2>&1; grep -l 'vault.centos.org' /etc/yum.repos.d/*.repo | head -1
